stories.headline: Point of Law wins the Melbourne Cup at Flemington
stories.summary: The 2026 Melbourne Cup was the 166th running of the race and was held on 3 November at Melbourne's Flemington Racecourse. Point of Law won it over 3,200 metres, jockeyed by Ethan Brown.

stories.headline: Cristina Fernández Cubas wins the Cervantes Prize
stories.summary: The Miguel de Cervantes Prize is awarded each year to honour the lifetime achievement of an outstanding writer in the Spanish language. It goes this year to Cristina Fernández Cubas, a Spanish writer and journalist who published her first collection of short stories in 1980. The winner receives €125,000.

stories.headline: Australia's central bank lifts its rate to its highest since 2008
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia has raised its benchmark interest rate by 0.25 percentage points to 4.85%. That is its highest level since 2008. The bank pointed to persistent inflation and rising energy costs.

stories.headline: All five molecular letters of life found on Ryugu
stories.summary: Samples brought back from the asteroid Ryugu contain all five fundamental nucleobases, the molecular letters of life. Japan's Hayabusa2 mission returned the samples from space in 2020. It delivered a total of 5.4 grams of pristine asteroid material.
